title: A Hormone-responsive 3D Culture Model of the Human Mammary Gland Epithelium
protocol: Dissolve promegestone in ethanol to make a 10-3 M stock solution.
Store the promegestone stock solution at -20°C for up to 6 months.
Dissolve 17-β-estradiol in ethanol to make a 10-3 M stock solution.
Store the estradiol stock solution at -20°C for up to 6 months.
Dissolve prolactin in distilled deionized water to make a 1 mg/ml stock solution.
Store the prolactin stock solution at -20°C for up to 6 months.
Dissolve ICI 182,780 in DMSO to make a 10-2 M stock solution.
Store the ICI 182,780 stock solution at -20°C for up to 6 months.
Heat-inactivate fetal bovine serum (FBS) in a 57 °C water bath for 30 min.
Weigh activated powdered charcoal, using 5% wt/vol relative to the volume of serum.
Wash charcoal twice with cold deionized distilled water using the same volume as the amount of serum.
Centrifuge washed charcoal at 50 x g for 2 min after each wash and remove supernatant.
Re-suspend last charcoal pellet in distilled, deionized water with 0.5% wt/vol Dextran T-70.
Incubate re-suspended mixture at 37°C while rolling (6 RPM) for 60 min.
Centrifuge the incubated mixture at 100 x g for 5 min and aspirate supernatant.
Add serum to the pellet of charcoal dextran and resuspend thoroughly.
Incubate the suspension at 37°C while rolling (6 RPM) for 60 min.
Centrifuge the suspension at 2,000 x g for 20 min.
Filter the supernatant if it appears cloudy.
Mix 375 ml of phenol red-free DMEM with 125 ml of DMEM/F-12.
Remove 37.5 ml from the mixture and replace it with an equal volume of Charcoal Dextran Stripped Fetal Bovine serum.
Add 106 U/ml penicillin and L-glutamine to a final concentration of 2 mM.
Filter all solutions through a 0.80 micron filter, then through a 0.45 micron filter, and finally sterilize with a 0.20 micron filter.
Store the filtered CDFBS media in glass tubes or T-25 culture flasks at -20°C.
Prepare 10X PBS, 1N NaOH, and distilled deionized water according to the required volume for collagen solution preparation.
Sterilize all solutions by filtering.
Store the 10x PBS and sterile distilled deionized water at 4°C for up to one month.
Do not store the 1N NaOH solution.
Prepare a collagen solution at a final concentration of 1 mg/ml according to the protocol provided by the manufacturer.
Make each gel using 1.5 ml of the prepared collagen solution.
Use the collagen solution immediately or hold it on ice for up to 2-3 hours.
Combine 1 g Carmine and 2.5 g Aluminum potassium sulfate in 500 ml distilled water.
Boil the mixture while stirring for 20 min, watching carefully to avoid boiling over.
Adjust final volume back to 500 ml with additional distilled water.
Add a crystal of thymol for antimicrobial activity and cover bottle with aluminum foil.
Filter through a laboratory grade paper filter before each use.
Re-suspend cell pellet in the appropriate volume of collagen using a cold-pipette.
Mix cells and collagen gently to avoid introducing bubbles.
Brush the borders, top, and bottom of the 12-well plate with a static-reducing brush after unwrapping.
Place the brushed 12-well plate on another similarly treated blank plate to avoid static charge buildup.
Pour 1.5 ml of the mix into each well of the 12-well plate.
Place the plate in an incubator at 37 °C for 30 min.
Remove the plate from the incubator and place it back in the hood.
Carefully detach the gel using a p200 sterile tip in a gentle circular motion from the border of each well.
Ensure the gel detaches from the bottom of the well as well.
Dilute E2 and R5020 to a final concentration of 10^-10 M in CDFBS media.
Add prolactin at a final concentration of 10^-7 M in CDFBS media.
Prepare control wells using CDFBS media with the highest volume of DMSO equivalent to hormone stocks but without hormones.
Ensure each well contains 1.5 ml of media, including hormone solutions or controls.
Place the 3D cultures inside a 37 °C, 5% CO2, 100% humidity tissue culture incubator.
Change the media every 2 days and maintain cultures for 1 or 2 weeks.
Remove culture media from wells after maintenance period.
Add 1.5 ml of PBS to each well.
Transfer the gel to a slide.
Cut the gel in half using a curved surgical blade.
Continue processing one half while saving the other for histological analysis.
Transfer the half gel for whole mount to a slide.
Let the gel dry for 5 min.
Transfer the slide to a coplin jar containing 10% formalin and fix gels overnight on a shaker.
Wash slides twice with PBS for 10 min each on a shaker.
Transfer slides to 70% EtOH; incubate for 1 hr on a shaker.
Transfer slides to Carmine Alum overnight.
Dehydrate slides in 70% EtOH, 95% EtOH, and 100% EtOH for 1 hr each on a shaker.
Transfer slides to xylene twice for 1 hr each and keep on a shaker.
Use toluene-based mounting medium to mount the gels with 1.5 mm thick coverslips.
Examine whole mounts under regular light (microscope or stereoscope).
For detailed analysis of shape and lumen, use confocal microscopy and visualize Carmine dye with HeNE 633 nm laser.
Transfer the remaining half of the gel to a 20 ml glass vial containing 10% formalin and fix on a shaker overnight.
Wash gels twice with PBS for 10 min each on a shaker.
Place gels into processing cassettes for paraffin embedding.
Transfer gels to 70% EtOH, incubate for 1 hr, followed by 95% EtOH for 1 hr and change to fresh 95% EtOH for 1 hr.
Incubate in 100% EtOH for 1 hr, then change to fresh 100% EtOH for 1 hr.
At this point, gels may be stored overnight at RT in 100% EtOH or incubated with xylene for 1 hr and again in fresh xylene for 1 hr.
Transfer cassettes to paraffin for 1 hr at 60 °C in a vacuum incubator, repeat with fresh paraffin twice more.
Fill plastic molds with clean paraffin.
Open the cassette, remove the gel and place it in the plastic mold containing paraffin.
Fill up with paraffin and add top of cassette containing the label on top.
Let block cool.
Remove the plastic mold.
Section the block using a microtome.
Obtain 5 um thick sections for H-E staining and immunocytochemistry.
Transfer gel from the well to a petri dish containing PBS.
Rinse gel briefly in PBS.
Transfer the gel to a 15 ml tube containing 2 ml of 0.125% collagenase.
Pipette up and down 4-5 times to break the gel into small pieces.
Incubate at 37 °C for 25 min until gel has dissolved and cells are in suspension.
Add 2 ml of serum supplemented culture medium to the tube.
Collect cells by centrifugation at 1,000 x g for 5 minutes.
Discard supernatant.
Re-suspend cells and count.
